_note: Church, persecution and Canada claims from August 2026 videos. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Mega churches close because they cannot pay their bills, alongside a shaking of the church and persecution, in the same window he tells people to fill their pockets with gold.
mentions.quote: I saw mega churches closing... not able to pay their bills

mentions.claim_text: Great persecution comes to Canada, with an Illuminati eye over Toronto in the days ahead, following Carney declaring Canada at war with the US over tariffs.
mentions.quote: I saw great persecution coming to Canada
mentions.falsify_match: State action against churches or religious speech in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: A major earthquake starts in British Columbia and talk of seceding from Canada follows, with a shaking of the Canadian economy, while Carney looks to Europe and China.
mentions.quote: they will talk about seceding from Canada in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A major BC quake followed by a secession movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No quake, or no secession politics after one.

mentions.claim_text: Things turn radical, the olive press comes and great revival with it, under socialistic control, with a warning to work while it is day.
mentions.quote: The olive press is coming. And great revival is coming
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as stated: pressure and revival are both self-assessed.

mentions.claim_text: Spots of revival come forth in the Middle East and over Iran as a stronghold there loosens, with new leaders of Iran dealt with.
mentions.quote: Spots of revival will come forth in the Middle East
mentions.falsify_match: Reported Christian growth in Iran alongside leadership change.
mentions.falsify_miss: No leadership change and no reported growth.

mentions.claim_text: New alliances are being born and old ones breaking, organised around oil and lumber, in a reshaping of the world economy.
mentions.quote: New alliances are being born. Old alliances
mentions.falsify_match: A visible realignment of trade blocs around energy and materials.
